== Template:Item/ClassRestrictions ==

Displays which classes can equip this item.

=== Parameters ===

The optional classes parameter carries comma-separated display names.

{| class="wikitable"
! Parameter !! Description
|-
| '''classes''' || Comma-separated class display names
|-
| '''class_levels''' || Comma-separated display names and levels when no separate class list is supplied
|}

=== Example ===

'''Code:'''
<pre>
{{Item/ClassRestrictions
|classes=Arcanist, Druid, Stormcaller
}}
</pre>

'''Result:'''

{{Item/ClassRestrictions
|classes=Arcanist, Druid, Stormcaller
}}

----
